title: Photosynthesis: Food from Sunlight
summary: Plants make glucose from carbon dioxide and water using light and chlorophyll, releasing oxygen. Limiting factors and the starch test.

ib.note: The balanced chemical equation is formalised in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 10: Life Processes in Plants

objectives: I can write the word equation for photosynthesis.
I can explain what limits the rate of photosynthesis.
I can plan and interpret experiments showing that photosynthesis needs light and chlorophyll.
misconceptions: Plants get their food from the soil.
Plants only photosynthesise and never respire.
Plants make oxygen for us on purpose.
